meta.north_trunk: push of 26 October 2026 (claude/North_Viaduct_Plan.md): RER B/D west of APEx Indianapolis; twin bores from Western; D peels off between the B tracks; Indianapolis + D west on one curve (D south side, R5 under); straights and single curves north of Arlington; viaduct ends at the Northside / Spring Grove platform end; extension of 26 October 2026: split at s 8,080 without crossings (X2, RER B, Dayton left; Norwood, ORR/TV straight on), Dayton on the ORR APEx alignment to the border, RER B over APEx between Paddock and Fairgrounds, Norwood branch with the TV peel and crossing to Norwood Central
meta.note: Platform lengths are canon (Ben, 2026-10-05); track centres and platform widths are drawing values, not canon.
meta.metro_spacing: By construction (Ben, 26 October 2026): bored (shield, deep tube) two single-track tubes 8 m apart; cut-and-cover, trough, at grade and elevated one double-track structure 3.9 m; types from the Rail Profiles page (saved profiles, else its defaults); runs under 60 m merged; 40 m transitions
